concerns.text: T012 mandates fetching from 'verified OQMD CSV URL' but does not name the specific URL or provide a mechanism to resolve it. The implementer cannot execute this task deterministically without the exact URL string, which is missing from the task description and not explicitly linked in the provided context.

T032 implements an 'override' of spec FR-004 to expand element sets (A={K,Rb,Cs,Ba,Sr}...) but fails to provide the formal amendment record or the specific text of the override in the task description. The implementer cannot verify the authority of this change or the exact new sets without external context not present in the task.

T034 requires an 'OOD check' comparing against 'min/max ranges derived from data/processed/features.csv' but does not specify the exact statistical method (e.g., Mahalanobis distance, bounding box, IQR) or the threshold for flagging. The task is ambiguous and non-deterministic for an implementer.

Tasks T020 (split), T021 (grid search), T022 (inner-loop selection), and T023 (re-training) are overly granular and split a single atomic requirement (FR-003: Model Training) into four separate tasks. This increases the risk of data leakage between steps and creates unnecessary dependency overhead. These should be consolidated into a single 'Implement Model Training with Nested CV' task.

T040 requires verifying runtime '≤ 6 hours' by executing 'time python code/main.py', but 'code/main.py' is not defined as a deliverable artifact in the implementation tasks (only individual scripts like download.py, train.py are). The task assumes the existence of an orchestration script that has not been explicitly created or named in the implementation phase.
